result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall recommendation is 1Password if ease of use and employee adoption matter most. Bitwarden is the better choice if you want strong security and team features at a lower price.

## My top 4 picks

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall experience)

Approximately C\$10.99/user/month for Business, or C\$29.95/month for the Starter Pack covering up to 10 users, billed annually.

- Excellent user experience
- Shared vaults and granular permissions
- Strong admin controls
- Excellent onboarding and offboarding

Website: [1Password Business](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

Approximately US\$4/user/month, billed annually.

- Open-source foundation
- Shared collections and organization management
- Audit logs and directory synchronization
- Excellent price-to-feature ratio

Website: [Bitwarden Business](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

Business Starter approximately US\$2/user/month, billed annually.

- Good administrative controls
- Shared team folders
- Additional security and compliance features
- Good for growing organizations

Website: [Keeper Business](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

Business plans start around US\$1.99/user/month for Essentials.

- Privacy-focused approach
- Secure sharing
- Email aliases
- Good budget-conscious alternative

Website: [Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Prices are approximate published prices checked in November 2026, before tax. Canadian billing, exchange rates and plan availability may vary. [www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[vettlo.com](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd prioritize for a small business

Regardless of which product you choose, make sure it supports\:

1. **Shared vaults\:** Share company credentials without sending passwords over Slack or email.
2. **Individual accounts\:** Every employee has their own login.
3. **Role-based permissions\:** Employees only see credentials they need.
4. **Easy offboarding\:** Revoke access immediately when someone leaves.
5. **MFA\:** Require multifactor authentication.
6. **Audit logs\:** Know who accessed or changed shared credentials.

## My recommendation depends on your team size

A few questions would help me narrow this down\:

**1\. How many people are on your team?**
